values.note: Book on RoverPass (instant booking, up to 18 months ahead); the engine is closed to bookings Nov 1 - May 21. Check in 2-9 pm at the campground manager's site; after 9 pm call the manager at 231-667-0100. Full refund until 1 day before arrival; no refund for early departures.

note: Village of Marion park on M-66 southeast of Cadillac, on the Middle Branch River Walk (the Middle Branch is a designated trout stream). Grassy sites; playground, basketball court, pavilions, ball fields and a disc golf course; grocery store, gas stations and restaurants within walking distance. No alcohol, ORVs or dirt bikes in the park. --Claude
summary: Village page + 2024 rate sheet + the village's RoverPass engine (claimed, instant booking): fees $20/$25 (confirmed; 2027 engine = 2024 sheet, one rate for all, weekly/monthly rates posted), hookups 50-amp/water/sewer (new; full-hookup and water/electric classes), max rig 50 ft (new; W/E sites to 45), showers/dump/wifi (new), reservable on RoverPass (confirmed) with bookings taken May 22 - Oct 31 (booking.season, from the engine's closure dates). No operating-season statement on the village pages; count 38 not stated (left). Not long-stay in character (no seasonal sites mentioned; nightly rates on an instant-book engine).
